requirements.text: Use authentic Sleepyhead logo artwork and appropriate supplied variants; preserve its proportions and clear space. Do not redraw, rotate, recolour, bevel, emboss, add a drop shadow, or place it on a low-contrast or busy background. Supplied excerpts are not production artwork and their approval/version is unknown.

The supplied excerpts specify orange #F15A22 and charcoal #414042. Treat these as supplied palette specifications, not verified production colour measurements; the excerpts’ approval/version is unknown. The stated white has conflicting HEX and RGB values, so confirm the corrected specification before using an exact white value.
The supplied excerpts name Migrena Grotesque for brand typography and Source Sans Pro for web. Confirm font availability and licensing before production; font binaries and licences were not supplied.
Use approachable, personable, informal and playful language; keep copy clear and useful, and do not make unsupported product promises.

preferences.text: Supplied room research suggests expressive but coherent domestic spaces: recognizable architecture and circulation, considered colour relationships, tactile materials, daylight, and lived-in activity. It includes both colourful rooms and quieter alternatives; references are inspiration, not required styling or Sleepyhead product evidence.

Explore playful colour, pattern, asymmetry, mixed styles, and occasional unexpected details while maintaining a coherent overall composition. These are supplied design directions, not a rule to use every device in every execution.

The official-site screenshot shows an orange-and-charcoal identity presentation, conversational shopping copy, and rounded interface elements. These are observed site patterns, not mandatory campaign rules.
The official site supplies a Sleepyhead logo image that may be inspected as a reference; use approved production artwork rather than treating a web image as a confirmed master file.

preserve: Sleepyhead’s supplied human-centred, playful and approachable identity, while noting the excerpts’ approval/version is unknown.
Authentic Sleepyhead logo appearance and exact product identity when a specific SKU is later selected.
The white-colour specification discrepancy; do not treat #231F20 as white or silently resolve the conflict.
explore: Use room-level inspiration—architecture, layout, colour relationships, light and lived-in activity—not just decorative props.
Consider both expressive and quieter colour treatments; orange need not recolour the room or product.
Treat any new campaign setting, lighting, people and composition as proposed creative choices unless separately approved.

Do not imply campaign claims, offers, SKU facts, or required assets have been approved in this reusable brief.

guide.decisionSummary: Use the supplied Sleepyhead identity as scoped guidance, not a replacement brandbook. Keep explicit logo, palette, typography and voice guidance distinct from observed website patterns and advisory room inspiration. Resolve source conflicts and confirm production assets before final execution; no campaign or product claims are approved here.
